text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and high tail latency observed in us-east-1 affecting Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Source: downstream auth/egress errors (STS/third-party egress). Pager triggered for @priya_oncall and @lisa-sre :rotating_light:
priya_oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Initial symptoms: spike in 500s for short text gen, timeouts from runtime -> auth broker. Impacting hosted endpoints and 2 dedicated pools in us-east-1. Investigating fallbacks now.
lisa-sre: I'm joining. Can you paste the top error we see?
priya_oncall: Logs: `2026-03-24T18:02:13Z ERROR auth-proxy request to sts.amazonaws.com timed out (connect timeout)` we see retries piling up, KV cache misses up 3x. Sample curl to auth-proxy returning 503:
```
curl -i https://auth-proxy.useast1.redwood.net/token -d '{"role":"svc"}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 18:02:13 GMT
```
emma.ops: Observability vendor (ingest endpoint in us-east-1) also showing 5xx-> logs delayed, so our tracing/alerts are partially blind. Opsbot shows increased error rate across agents.
jay.eng: Recommending immediate traffic steering: enable region-fallback routing for Hosted API to us-west-2 + eu-west-1, and shift Dedicated pool traffic from affected AZs to healthy hosts. Canary 10% first.
lisa-sre: Agreed. @priya_oncall can you flip fallback policy? I'll prepare capacity adjustments.
priya_oncall: Flipping fallback routing to us-west-2/eu-west-1 now (policy id: r-fallback-03). Applying canary: 10% => 50% after 3 min if no regressions.
(1m later) incident-bot: Routing change applied: canary 10% success, no immediate regressions.
priya_oncall: Increasing Dedicated pool replica count for dp-us-east-1-gpu-1 by +2 to reduce queueing and KV cache pressure. Scaling command: `infractl scale pool dp-us-east-1-gpu-1 --replicas +2`
jay.eng: Also enabling short-term circuit breaker on auth-proxy client: fail fast on 500s to avoid head-of-line retries. Patch pushed to runtime: `auth.client.timeout=1500ms, auth.client.max_retries=1`.
carlos-support: Heads up, prepping banner for status.redwood.ai: "Investigating elevated API errors in us-east-1; cross-region fallback in progress. Some requests may see higher latency or 503s. Updates to follow." Draft ready, need approval.
priya_oncall: Approved. Publish now. Also contacting top tier customers with dedicated pools in us-east-1 (account owners list) — will send an L1 update.
(20m later) incident-bot: Observability ingest recovered in us-east-1 (partial). Some delayed logs now visible. Error rate dropping from peak 18% -> 4%.
lisa-sre: AWS STATUS page shows STS regional degradation in us-east-1. Looks like third-party egress/route instability. We're continuing with traffic steering; hold on full failover until metrics stable.
priya_oncall: Canary moved 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 18 minutes with no new spikes in fallback regions. Bringing dedicated pool traffic to fallback as well.
sre-manager: Good mitigation. Please keep a timeline and assign postmortem owner. Also coordinate with legal if any SLA alerts triggered.
priya_oncall: Assigning postmortem owner: @lisa-sre. We'll capture timeline, root cause (AWS STS/egress instability), mitigation steps, and followups (improve multi-region KV caching, add auth-proxy local token cache, refine circuit breaker thresholds).
carlos-support: Sent targeted emails to 7 affected customers with short impact summary and mitigation steps.
jay.eng: Post-mitigation adjustments: revert scale-up after stabilizes, leave circuit breaker in a less-aggressive mode for 24h. We'll also add synthetic auth checks in us-east-1 every 30s to detect regressions earlier.
(55m later) incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — routing fallback and pool scaling reduced user-facing errors to baseline. Closing pager for @priya_oncall.
priya_oncall: Closing the active incident. Will start postmortem doc and schedule review with SRE/infra/eng next week. Thanks everyone for quick coordination. :heart:
lisa-sre: Adding followups: (1) add region-aware token cache with TTL fallback, (2) update runbook for auth-egress incidents, (3) test cross-region failover during capacity test.
sre-manager: Noted. Please include estimated customer impact and any SLA credits in the postmortem.
priya_oncall: Will include. End of thread.
